title: Closeout summary: S01T03 - Define directive families and precedence matrix
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Defined the canonical Agent Directive families and precedence matrix in docs/architecture/AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md. Added family keys for closeout, git, sprint, phase, container, handoff, doctor, blocked, verification, review, audit, memory, and workflow_next; added severity, audience, kind, lifecycle, source metadata, precedence order, and conflict examples. Validated with git diff --check on the doc, bwrk docs check --json, bwrk schema validate --json, bwrk sync refresh --json, and bwrk doctor --strict --json.

Close reason: completed directive family and precedence contract
